en.ui.title: QC Tablet
en.ui.waiting_approval: Waiting for device approval or activation
en.ui.saved_offline: Saved on device; will sync when online
en.ui.camera_permission: Allow camera access to scan QR
en.error.auth: Device is not approved or active.
en.error.factory_company_required: Factory must be assigned to a company before importing.
en.error.line_company: Line is outside the registered company.
en.error.unknown_master: Selected master record does not exist.
en.error.quantity: Quantity must be greater than zero.
en.ok.register: Device registered. The page will open automatically after approval.
en.ui.register_prompt: Enter a device ID or scan a QR code to register.
en.ui.waiting_pairing: This device is waiting for administrator approval.
en.ui.arrange_hint: Press and hold a defect card, drag it to a new position, then release. You can also tap two cards in sequence.
en.error.fullscreen: Could not change full screen mode.
en.error.device_paired: This device is paired with another browser. Use a separate device ID or ask an administrator to reset pairing.
en.error.client_revoked: This browser pairing was rejected or revoked.
en.error.cache_pending: {count} items are pending sync. Sync before clearing the cache.
en.error.cache_offline: Go online before clearing the cache and reloading.
en.error.cache_busy: Sync is in progress. Wait until it finishes.
en.error.device_id_locked: This device ID is registered. Clear the device cache to register another ID.
en.error.device_identity_conflict: Stored device IDs conflict. The offline queue is preserved; verify the ID before syncing.
en.IMPORT_QC_INSERT_ONLY: Only Insert New Records is supported for QC Inspection Event.
en.IMPORT_QC_ID_MUST_BE_BLANK: Leave the Frappe ID column blank for new records. Rows: {rows} ({row_count}).
en.IMPORT_QC_MISSING_LINK: {field} ?{value}? does not exist in the catalog. Rows: {rows} ({row_count}).
en.IMPORT_QC_LINE_COMPANY: Device and Line belong to different companies. Rows: {rows} ({row_count}).
en.IMPORT_QC_WRONG_DEFECT_TYPE: Defect must refer to a detail record, not a group. Rows: {rows} ({row_count}).
en.IMPORT_QC_EVENT_TYPE_LENGTH: Event Type must not exceed 100 characters. Rows: {rows} ({row_count}).
en.IMPORT_QC_QUANTITY: Quantity Delta must be an integer. Rows: {rows} ({row_count}).
en.IMPORT_QC_FUTURE_SYNCED_AT: Synced At is in the future; correct the Excel values. Rows: {rows} ({row_count}).
en.IMPORT_QC_SYNCED_BEFORE_OCCURRED: Synced At precedes Occurred At. Rows: {rows} ({row_count}).
en.IMPORT_QC_LOCAL_EVENT_ID_LENGTH: Local Event ID must not exceed 100 characters. Rows: {rows} ({row_count}).
en.IMPORT_QC_DUPLICATE_LOCAL_EVENT_ID: Device and Local Event ID are duplicated in this file. Rows: {rows} ({row_count}).
en.IMPORT_QC_EXISTING_CONFLICT: The event ID already exists with different data. Rows: {rows} ({row_count}).
en.IMPORT_QC_ROW_UNAVAILABLE: The event row is no longer available for import; reload the file and try again.
